CAUSE: The merge selected the worker branch itself as the target. In `app/merge_operations.py`, the target defaults to the request’s `target`, then the session’s `base_branch`; in `app/workspace.py`, `merge_worktree_to_main` returns `NO_COMMITS_MERGED` when the target ref and worker HEAD are the same commit. That explains why `main` did not move.

The supplied branch facts alone don’t show the session’s stored `base_branch` or the operation’s target, so they don’t prove which value caused the self-target. Check the operation result’s `target_branch` and the session’s `base_branch`: if either is `task-416/worker`, that confirms it.

Fix: set the session base branch or merge request target to `main`, then start a fresh merge operation. Repeating the same operation may replay its recorded result.
